title: Ender Buffer
subtitle: LV, 8 FE/t, 27 shared slots
text:
Every Ender Buffer on the same code shares one set of 27 slots, across any distance and any dimension. Give it a code with a Link Card.

Pipes and hoppers can put items in and take them out on any side, even on a private buffer; private only locks the screen and the code.

It uses 8 FE/t and holds 20k FE. Without power it stops sharing until power comes back. Breaking or taking it apart keeps its code, and the items stay on the code.
caption: Two buffers, one inventory
